# Miozuki

> Japanese-inspired fine jewellery studio in Auckland, New Zealand, specialising in moissanite rings, earrings, necklaces, and custom bridal pieces, crafted in genuine 925 sterling silver. Ships to New Zealand and Australia.

Miozuki is a small, founder-led business (Ting Eguchi) designing accessible, everyday fine jewellery with real lab-grown moissanite and freshwater pearl. All pieces are made to order and shipped from Auckland.

## Shop
- [Moissanite Rings](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/moissanite-rings): Solitaire, halo, three-stone, and eternity ring styles in moissanite and sterling silver.
- [Moissanite Earrings](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/moissanite-earrings): Studs, hoops, and drop earrings in moissanite and sterling silver.
- [Pearl Earrings](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/pearl-earrings): Freshwater baroque pearl and moissanite-pearl duo earrings.
- [Moissanite & Pearl (shop all)](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/moissanite-nz): The full catalogue across rings, earrings, necklaces, and pearls.
- [Bridal Jewellery](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/bridal-jewellery): Curated moissanite and pearl pieces for weddings.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.miozuki.co.nz/collections/best-sellers)
